name: Emirates
verdict: The airline is owned by the Dubai government’s investment arm.

why.text: Dubai is part of the United Arab Emirates, where criticising the government can land you in prison. In 2024, 43 activists got life sentences in a single mass trial. Putting Emirates on a famous shirt makes the country look good to millions of fans while that goes on. That’s called sportswashing.
why.messageLine: In 2024, 43 activists in the UAE got life sentences in one mass trial.
